title: Security Agreement
description: Security Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-security-agreement
  title: Security Agreement
  description: Security Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_security_agreement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/security_agreement
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/security_agreement
    sourceVersion: fs_security_agreement_v1
    sourceDigest: 402cd6bb723fa90cfc5050c947ea47831875a35d81742077722f9bc534784a9f
spec:
  documentType: security_agreement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - covenants
        - debtor-representations
        - governing-law
        - remedies
        - signature-title
        - underlying-obligation-reference
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - perfection-requirements
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - borrower-name
        - debtor-name
        - secured-party-name
        - signature-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - all-assets-clause
        - collateral-categories
        - collateral-description
        - excluded-collateral
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - events-of-default
  fields:
    - id: agreement-date
      name: agreement_date
      label: Agreement Date
      description: Date of security agreement.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_date
    - id: debtor-name
      name: debtor_name
      label: Debtor Name
      description: Grantor or debtor.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/debtor_name
    - id: secured-party-name
      name: secured_party_name
      label: Secured Party Name
      description: Secured party or lender.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/secured_party_name
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower if different from debtor.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: underlying-obligation-reference
      name: underlying_obligation_reference
      label: Underlying Obligation Reference
      description: Note, loan agreement, or obligations secured.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/underlying_obligation_reference
    - id: collateral-description
      name: collateral_description
      label: Collateral Description
      description: Granting clause collateral description.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_description
    - id: all-assets-clause
      name: all_assets_clause
      label: All Assets Clause
      description: Whether agreement grants all assets or substantially all assets.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/all_assets_clause
    - id: collateral-categories
      name: collateral_categories
      label: Collateral Categories
      description: Accounts, inventory, equipment, general intangibles, deposit accounts, investment property,
        fixtures, vehicles, real estate-related, or other.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_categories
    - id: excluded-collateral
      name: excluded_collateral
      label: Excluded Collateral
      description: Collateral excluded from grant.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/excluded_collateral
    - id: perfection-requirements
      name: perfection_requirements
      label: Perfection Requirements
      description: UCC filing, possession, control, title notation, mortgage, account control agreement, or other.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/perfection_requirements
    - id: debtor-representations
      name: debtor_representations
      label: Debtor Representations
      description: Key representations about ownership, liens, location, authority, etc.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/debtor_representations
    - id: covenants
      name: covenants
      label: Covenants
      description: Collateral maintenance, insurance, records, inspection, transfer restrictions, etc.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/covenants
    - id: events-of-default
      name: events_of_default
      label: Events Of Default
      description: Defaults under the agreement.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/events_of_default
    - id: remedies
      name: remedies
      label: Remedies
      description: Remedies available to secured party.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/remedies
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
    - id: signature-name
      name: signature_name
      label: Signature Name
      description: Signer name.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/signature_name
    - id: signature-title
      name: signature_title
      label: Signature Title
      description: Signer title.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/signature_title
  validationRules:
    - id: debtor-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Security agreement must identify the debtor or grantor.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: debtor_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: debtor_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: debtor_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(debtor_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: secured-party-present
      severity: warning
      description: Secured party should be captured for collateral controls.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: secured_party_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: secured_party_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: secured_party_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(secured_party_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: collateral-description-present
      severity: warning
      description: Collateral description is required to use a security agreement extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: collateral_description
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: collateral_description
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: collateral_description IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(collateral_description)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: collateral-categories-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Collateral categories should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: collateral_categories
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: collateral_categories
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: collateral_categories IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(collateral_categories) >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: perfection-requirements-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Perfection requirements should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: perfection_requirements
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: perfection_requirements
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: perfection_requirements IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(perfection_requirements) >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      debtor_name:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Debtor name anchors the security interest.
      secured_party_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Secured party identifies beneficiary of the collateral grant.
      collateral_description:
        minConfidence: 0.86
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Collateral grant defines the secured party's rights.
      all_assets_clause:
        minConfidence: 0.88
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: All-assets grants affect lien scope and monitoring.
      perfection_requirements:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Perfection requirements drive post-closing collateral controls.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Security agreements require detailed extraction of collateral grants, excluded collateral,
      covenants, perfection, default, and remedies.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      agreement_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of security agreement.
        format: date
      debtor_name:
        type: string
        description: Grantor or debtor.
      secured_party_name:
        type: string
        description: Secured party or lender.
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower if different from debtor.
      underlying_obligation_reference:
        type: string
        description: Note, loan agreement, or obligations secured.
      collateral_description:
        type: string
        description: Granting clause collateral description.
      all_assets_clause:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether agreement grants all assets or substantially all assets.
      collateral_categories:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Accounts, inventory, equipment, general intangibles, deposit accounts, investment property,
          fixtures, vehicles, real estate-related, or other.
      excluded_collateral:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Collateral excluded from grant.
      perfection_requirements:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: UCC filing, possession, control, title notation, mortgage, account control agreement, or other.
      debtor_representations:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Key representations about ownership, liens, location, authority, etc.
      covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Collateral maintenance, insurance, records, inspection, transfer restrictions, etc.
      events_of_default:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Defaults under the agreement.
      remedies:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Remedies available to secured party.
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      signature_name:
        type: string
        description: Signer name.
      signature_title:
        type: string
        description: Signer title.
    required:
      - debtor_name
      - collateral_description
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - debtor_name
          - collateral_description
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
